newsitem.title: USA: FHLMC sets three REMICs totaling $755 mln.
newsitem.headline: FHLMC sets three REMICs totaling $755 mln.

text.p: The Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp (Freddie Mac or FHLMC) said it issued $755 million of Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) Securities.
REMIC series 1925 totals $250 million and is underwritten by Lehman Bros, Freddie Mac said. The issue pays a coupon of 7.5 percent, the agency said.
The issue, backed by collateral C030, priced on December 17 and has a settlement date of January 30, Freddie Mac said.
REMIC series 1927, underwritten by Bear Stearns Cos Inc, totals $505 million, FHLMC said. The issue priced on December 18 and has a settlement date of January 30, the agency said.
The issue is backed by 30-year single family, floating rate mortgages, with $300 million having a 7.5 percent coupon and $205 million having a 6.5 percent coupon, Freddie Mac said.
